reviewer: Catalog-count review (independent agent, local stored pages only), 2026-10-21

catalogs.completeness_basis: Official 'Majors/Areas of Study' A-Z list (Undergraduate Catalog 2026-2027, catalog.unl.edu/undergraduate/majors/); the list prints no awards, so each entry was judged from its label and its own stored page's 'Degree Offered:' row. Counted 124 entries (Data Science CAS/ENGR and Microbiology CAS/CASNR each counted separately; the three Nutrition & Health Sciences option entries counted separately as printed); excluded minor-only, certificate, graduate (Actuarial Science MS), pre-professional/non-degree entries and college/policy/nav links. 106 counted entries match an approved record by URL; 18 have no record: 4 whose pages print a bachelor's Degree Offered row, and 14 unconfirmed (no stored Degree Offered row: 13 pages not crawled, Modern Languages page prints none) counted in the safe direction. After the count review, the Art, Music, ALEC and HRTM pages (comma-separated award rows) were read, reviewed and matched.
